hardcoded_fixture_risks: The test signing keys are fixed seeds. This is intentional and does not weaken the tests: the properties under test are key-relative (different keys must produce different signatures, a signature must not transfer between packs), so a fixed key exercises them fully.
catch_and_ignore_risks: The domain tag mutation survives. It is genuine defence in depth rather than a tested control, and is recorded as such rather than left unmentioned.
reason: EP-002's closure was not supportable as originally recorded: its evidence directory held a unit-tests exit code of 1 on a NODE_DONE node, three .sha256 files hashing logs that were never committed, and no anti-gaming review (the original was a three-line {"verdict":"PASS"} sticker, deleted in 65ca5f4). This review does not attest to the original session's work, which it could not verify.

remediation_performed: Deleted crates/vector-domain/src/plan.rs. The real planner already exists in vector_study::selection from EP-004; two implementations of one concept, one real and one fake, is worse than one.
Replaced ContentPack::sign with real Ed25519 signing. The previous method returned the literal "dummy_signature", ignored the key, and force-set reviewed = true.
Removed the domain copies of AnswerProof and QuestionItem, superseded by vector_questions::ingestion (EP-007).
Regenerated every gate log and exit code in this directory from real command runs.
known_limitations: REQ-003's planner is implemented in vector_study::selection (EP-004), not in this crate. It cannot live in vector-domain because vector-study depends on it. The traceability row should reflect EP-004 as the implementation site.
REQ-022's question factory is implemented in vector_questions::ingestion (EP-007), not in this crate, for the same layering reason.
Lifecycle state (status, freshness) is deliberately not covered by the signature. A consumer that needs to attest when a pack was reviewed must use the content QA ledger, not the signature.
Content packs are signed in memory. No key provisioning, rotation or revocation is implemented, and PREFLIGHT PF-013 (content signing test key) remains an external capability probe.
